# Kamruzzaman Polash

Builds custom business software, multi-branch POS platforms, e-commerce automation, courier & payment pipelines (Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, CarryBee, bKash, SSLCommerz), and scalable SaaS backends. Available for client projects and remote full-time engineering roles worldwide.
